# #1751: Patch: Update how multiple activates work
Opened by @jgoetzmann.

### What it does

When a card with an activate get's fused with another card that has an activate when the activate button is click it should open up a discover type panel that lets you pick which activate you want to do. Each activates cooldown and effects are also considered separate. 

For example if I have a field spell that has "activate 1: draw 1" and I fuse in a different field spell with "activate 1: heal your hero 5 health"; when I click the activate on the field spell it should then pop up a menu where I get to pick which of the two activates I want to choose, then it triggers that effect while then leaving the other activate open if I also want to trigger it in the same turn.

### Acceptance

Engine updated with this functionality.
